# gyro_server_agent (Resource)

Keeps the Gyro guest agent of a Gyro Cloud Istanbul (tr-ist-1) server up to date (GET /cloud/servers/{id}/agent, POST .../agent/update). Servers installed before private networking (agent 3) need agent 4 before gyro_server_nic / gyro_server_public_ip can turn the public IP off. With keep_updated = true (default) every apply that finds a newer agent updates it in place (only the Gyro agent is replaced; data, applications and settings are not touched, no restart) and waits until the new version reports. Very old agents (before 3) cannot update themselves: apply fails with the one-line command to run on the server. Destroy only stops managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the Gyro guest agent current (needed for gyro_server_nic / gyro_server_public_ip on servers installed before 14 Nov 2026).
resource "gyro_server_agent" "db" {
  server_id = tonumber(gyro_server.db.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Gyro Cloud Istanbul server id (gyro_server.id).

### Optional

- `keep_updated` (Boolean) true = update the agent when a newer version is available (the next plan shows it as an in-place change). false = only report.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as server_id.
- `latest` (String) Newest agent version.
- `network_applied` (Boolean) The private network settings are applied on the server.
- `private_network_supported` (Boolean) The agent supports private networks (VPC, public IP off).
- `update_available` (Boolean) A newer agent exists.
- `version` (String) Agent version on the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_server_agent.db 12345
```
